'''''Siak''-series [[Protocol droid/Legends|protocol droids]]''' were a model designed by [[Roche Hive Mechanical Apparatus Design and Construction Activity for Those Who Need the Hive's Machines/Legends|Roche Hive Mechanical Apparatus Design and Construction Activity for Those Who Need the Hive's Machines]]. They were equipped with a [[Tranlang IV Communications module]], two [[Photoreceptor/Legends|Photoreceptors]], two auditory receptors, a languages database, a [[Verpine/Legends|Verpinoid]] body and head, and a [[Vocabulator/Legends|vocabulator]]. They stood 1.5 meters tall and cost 3,500 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] new (1,200 credits used). The model was Roche's great success after the failure of the [[J9 worker drone/Legends|J9 worker drone]], in part because Roche hired human engineers to develop the droid's chassis and personality matrix, so as to make them more appealing to mammalian species.
